Cost: 5,000eb (Luxury)
Type: Cyberarm (Foundational)
Install: Hospital
Humanity Loss: 21 (6d6)
Option Slots: uses 0, provides 1

Paired Cyberarms. Borgware. They install together and count as one item for Cost and Humanity Loss, but not for Critical Injuries or repair. Each arm has 1 Option Slot for Cyberarm or Cyberlimb Options, and comes with a Gorilla Arm (with Tungsten Reinforcement) and a Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrade pre-installed, neither of which costs Humanity Loss or takes an Option Slot. None of the pre-installed items can be removed.

Foundry notes:

  • One item for the pair, as Corgo prices and installs them together. It carries 1 Option Slot, the count for one arm; add a second copy or raise the slots by hand if your table tracks each arm separately.
  • The pre-installed Gorilla Arm and Reinforced Cyberlimb Upgrade are described here rather than installed as separate items.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
